Name: Phineas
Dialog: It sounds like somebody is strangling a cat! It must be Grandpa! Wakey wakey, eggs and bakey!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Coughing) I cannot believe we eat the same food.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Burps) Believe it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Grandma, would you show me where the shower is?

Name: Grandma Betty Jo
Dialog: Shower? Why, sure honey. Would you like a massage and a fruity drink too? How about a manicure and a mud facial while you lay by the pool eating crab cakes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can do without the sarcasm.

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: Chow time's over, campers. Time for our nature walk to Badbeard Lake.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why do they call it "Badbeard Lake"?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Well, it's a body of fresh water surrounded by land―

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, the "Badbeard" part.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Oh, right. It was named after "Badbeard", the most ruthless freshwater pirate ever to plunder a lakeside community.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Cool!/Wow!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: And in the middle of Badbeard Lake lies Spleen Island, where legend has it Badbeard buried his bountiful booty. Heh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Booty?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: You know, treasure.

Name: Kids
Dialog: (Gasps) Treasure?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Aye, mateys- Oh, just a sec. (Marker squeaks as he colors in the lens of his glasses) Arrrgh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why are you talking like a pirate, Grandpa?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Arrrgh! I'm trying to tell the story of Badbeard the Pirate. There's a song about it. Say, does anyone have a concertina? Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Me? (Pulls out concertina) Yes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Well, I didn't say it was much of a song. So, meet me at the trail head in 5 minutes.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Aye-aye, Captain Grandpa!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: That's the spirit!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Stretching out his overalls) Oh, dear. I seem to be missing my underpants.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Laughs)

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Ah you see, kids, wherever you go, the forest is teeming with life for us to step on. Remember, always stick to the trail so you won't get lost. And whatever you do, never touch the orange moss that grows on the right side of the Jum-Jum tree.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Boring. I'm calling Stacy.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Left is right. Right is wrong.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't get any reception up here.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: So stay clear of the moss. The slightest touch, and the orange moss will absorb through the skin, causing wild hallucinations.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? Oh no! Was that the right side or the wrong side? No, wait. The left side was the right side. (gasps) Moss! Orange! (screams; runs off)

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Thar she blows mateys. Badbeard Lake.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Ooh!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: And thar be Spleen Island. (gasps) The bones of them that hunted the treasure all be lyin' below in Davy Jones's locker.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Let's go!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Candace? Where's Candace?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P, and thank you for your help, Agent E. Sorry if we alarmed you, Agent P, we're remodeling our regular base here. Actually, my wife's doing it Mexican-country style. Distressed wood, wrought iron. It should all be very- (Agent E feeds worms to the Monogram Egg) Woah! Hey, woah! Hey, Agent E, back off! Anyway, Agent E spotted Dr. Doofenshmirtz on Spleen Island. He's moving boxes and equipment into what's known as the haunted cave of the old sea hag. Honestly, I'm not making this stuff up. But anyway, we believe he's creating a new hideout there, and we want you to foil his plans. Good luck, Agent P.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (After seeing Perry) No way. This is so weird. I see Perry with an eagle, and their both dressed up like secret agents and they're talking to man inside an egg. (Snickers) That is so messed up. It must be the moss. Hey, wait a minute. (Sees she's at the top of a tree) How did I get way up here? (Screams, Coughs; Eagle calls) Now Perry has a wetski? (Gasps) How strange can this get?

Name: Talking Zebra
Dialog: (Knitting; Appears out of nowhere) Oh, it gets much stranger, Kevin.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams)

Name: Buford
Dialog: En garde, you scurvy dog!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ha! I don't even know what scurvy is!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey! I know what we should do today! Let's be real pirates, and go find Badbeard's treasure.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: (Laughs) Sure, knock yourselves out. I was just about your age when I first heard about Badbeard's treasure. I'd come up here every summer and search for it. But I felt drawn by the excitement and adventure. Of course, then I discovered girls and the rest is a blur. I never found the treasure, but I did find a treasure map.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Treasure map? Hey!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (laughs) Woah!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: But be warned, mateys. They say Badbeard's treasure comes with a curse.

Name: Kids
Dialog: "A curse"?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Aye! Them who disturb the treasure of Badbeard shall be cursed with bad beards for the rest of their days.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You mean we'll be stuck with a big, ugly beard on our face for the rest of our lives?

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's gnarly.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Well, while you kids search for treasure, I better go search for Grandma. Wish there was a map for that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screaming)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, troops. We set sail from Point Plots, sail through the Stones of Gall, and into the Cove of Incontinence, and then continue on foot into the Dark Tunnel of Doom. Well, that sounds delightful. And "X" marks the spot. Easy-peasy. First thing we gotta do is, we make Grandpa's secondhand dingy into a first-rate pirate ship. Ferb, any ideas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woah. Impressive.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hehhehheh, hehheh, ee-ee-ee-ee, hahahaheeheehee.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is that the cable company? So, Mr. Cable Man, you don't carry the Evil Science Channel? What's up with— Perry the Platypus?! Oh, give me a break! I-I'm moving, legally. I bought this place, and cheap too. It's supposed to be haunted by a terrifying old sea hag. (Laughs) Look, Perry the Platypus, just because I'm evil doesn't mean everything I do is evil.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Fine! You want evil, Perry the Platypus? I'll give you evil!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Avast, me 'arties!

Name: Holly
Dialog: I'm feeling sick.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: You're looking green.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Rings bell)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is it. The Tunnel of Doom. Just like on the map.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Are you sure we're going the right way?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure I'm sure. We just follow Ferb. He's got the map.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh oh. Oh well, I'm sure it's pretty straightforward from here. Heh, heh.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It doesn't look very safe.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think you'd better test it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem. It'll hold us.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, wait! Not all at once!

Name: All
Dialog: (Screaming)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Run for it!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh my gosh! Buford, what are you doing?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Look! I found these nifty hand puppets!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well stop fooling around and let's go.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, all right.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This place is creeping me out. If I had any underpants left, I am sure they would have been soiled.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, we're not getting lost, are we?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, Dinner Bell. What if there is no treasure?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Perhaps the real treasure is true friendship and the spirit of adventure.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah, there it is over there. "X" marks the spot.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look. There's the chest.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But who d-dare open it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'll open it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But Phineas, what about the curse?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bad beards forever, dude.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You don't even have a chin.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's a chance I'll have to take. Shiver me timbers! The curse is true! We will have bad beards forever!

Name: Isabella/Baljeet/Buford
Dialog: Oh no!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's full of bad fake beards.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, Perry the Platypus, why don't you say hello to my new pet crocodiles? Susan and Susan. I named them after each other. Now, prepare to be delicious!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Laughing maniacally)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Gasps) The sea hag!

Name: Candace
Dialog: The pharmacist!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey Perry, I'm gonna get a snack from the vending machine. You want something? Suit yourself. I'm gonna have me some beef jerky! (Presses button; the alarm starts beeping.)

Name: Computer Voice
Dialog: Island Self Destruct Sequence activated.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, my beef jerky!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAH! Someone always finds my self-destruct button! (Sighs) Curse you, Perry the Platypus, blah blah blah.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: These are the best bad beards ever!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Quick, grab as many beards as you can carry and let's get out of here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cast off. Put your backs into it, mateys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: WEE!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh man, woah!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Astonishing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, by the way, where's Per- Oh, never mind.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey Perry, what happened to your cute little secret agent hat?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well Ferb, me ol' matey, our first time out as pirates, and we come home with a bounty of beards.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: And perhaps the greatest pirate story ever told.

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: Wow, that's the greatest pirate story ever told!

Name: Grandma Betty Jo
Dialog: Oh. How are you feeling, honey?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, better. Thanks, Grandma. Can you believe I actually thought Perry was a secret agent?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I learned my lesson. Stay away from the orange moss.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: The orange moss? Is that what your Grandpa said? Oh, he always gets that wrong. It's the blue moss you gotta watch out for.

Name: Candace
Dialog: W-what?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: I guess it was all in your head. Well, that's the power of suggestion for you. You get some rest now, sweetie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The blue moss. (Places hand in blue moss) What? Ohh.

Name: Talking Zebra
Dialog: (Appears out of nowhere, knitting) Love the beard, Kevin.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Avast, me 'arties!

Name: Holly
Dialog: I'm feeling sick.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: You're looking green.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Rings bell)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bad beards forever, dude.
